# The validation function applies an XOR operation with the index
# Then adds the index to the result and compares with hardcoded values
# We need to reverse this process

# Hardcoded values from .rodata section
encoded = [0x66, 0x6e, 0x65, 0x67, 0x83, 0x72, 0x3b, 0x72, 
          0x80, 0x5f, 0x45, 0x71, 0x5f, 0x86, 0x8a, 0x4a,
          0x70, 0x72, 0x33, 0x8a, 0x5f, 0x39, 0x8e, 0x5f,
          0x82, 0x46, 0x84, 0x86, 0x4b, 0x96, 0x5f, 0x4d,
          0x6e, 0x9f, 0x38, 0x3a, 0x34, 0x36, 0x38, 0x3a,
          0x44, 0x46, 0x81]

# Function to reverse the encoding
def decode_char(encoded_val, index):
    # Original: (index ^ char) + index = encoded_val
    # Therefore: char = (encoded_val - index) ^ index
    return (encoded_val - index) ^ index

# Decode the flag
flag = ""
for i in range(len(encoded)):
    flag += chr(decode_char(encoded[i], i))

print(flag)
